description: Use this whenever the person needs a font, before naming one from memory: every family it finds is free for any use and loads from one link. Their words can name a style or mood, a use, a font, or a language to cover, for example "a warm serif", "a playful display font for a poster" or "a monospace for code". query is their words, at most 200 characters. category narrows to sans-serif, serif, monospace, display or handwriting. language keeps fonts that fully cover latin, latin-extended, ukrainian, greek, vietnamese, arabic, hebrew, thai, japanese, korean, chinese-simplified or devanagari. limit is 1 to 20, 8 when left out. Not for fonts installed on the person's computer, and not for paid fonts: the catalog holds free fonts only. Answers free, openly licensed font families from the onlyfonts catalog, best match first, each with its id, name, page link, category, designer and how many styles it has.

language.description: only fonts that fully cover this language

query.description: their words: a style, a mood, a use, a font's name
